findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "«Adabiyot atomdan kuchli, lekin uning kuchini o'" → 3 lines (12 words, 38.4px, a paragraph set above 36px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 3 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "1907–1968 · o'zbek adabiyoti" (pill) above "Abdulla Qahhor hikoyalari va hayoti"; "Barchasi" above "1934"; "Barchasi" above "1951"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 40 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.absolute.left-4 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | ul.list-none.m-0 → rgba(14, 38, 39, 0.06) 0px 8px 30px 0px | a.group.card → rgba(14, 38, 39, 0.06) 0px 8px 30px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.6:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 93 characters per line.

findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The sheet dealt STIX Two Text and STIX Two Text, but the page renders Onest.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 1150px of nothing between: "Mashhur asarlari"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (72px, 93px, 128px, 534px, 972px, 413px, 575px); the three most used hold only 52% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 768px: "«Adabiyot atomdan kuchli, lekin uning ku…" → 5 lines at 29.8px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.

findings.message: No visible button in the first screen.
findings.fix: Give the one primary action a real button in the first screen (a filled or solid-bordered control, 44px or taller), not only a link in the navigation.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "hikoyalari va hayoti" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "O'g'ri" (screen 2, 100% hidden); "Bemor" (screen 2, 100% hidden); "Sayt sizga nimalarni beradi" (screen 3, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
